note: Each profession grants three camp objects, the first at around 20 skill, the later two upgraded from dungeon blueprints. A basic campfire holds three objects and each player may contribute one.

objects.name: Enchanted Lute
objects.buff: +163 armour, +7 all stats, +6 all resistances at level 30

objects.name: Faction Banner
objects.buff: +14 Spirit at level 30, own faction only

objects.name: Camp Tent
objects.buff: rested XP, up to 5% of a level, for everyone sitting nearby

objects.name: Tanning Rack
objects.buff: not published anywhere; only one source even gives the skill level

objects.name: Camp Chair
objects.buff: +2% critical strike on all spells and attacks for everyone nearby

objects.name: Field Guide
objects.buff: +2% crit plus Track Beasts for whoever reads it; blueprint drop, no source names the boss

objects.name: Trapper's Workbench
objects.buff: +2% crit plus a trap; which traps is still unclear
